DRY 允许重复的连续令牌数。推荐 2~3。设为 2 只允许 2 个词重复，更长: DRY allowed consecutive repeated tokens. Recommend 2~3. Set to 2 for 2-word repetitions. Default 2.

Mirostat 目标熵。越高越随机。推荐：对话 4.0，故事 5.0，代码 3: Mirostat target entropy. Higher = more random. Recommend: chat 4.0, story 5.0, code 3.0. Default 5.0.

展开高级采样参数。建议一次只开一组：日常用 Mirostat，长文防重复用 DR: Expand advanced sampling parameters. Recommended: use one group at a time -- Mirostat for daily, DRY for anti-repetition, XTC for creative writing.
XTC 阈值。词的概率超过此值即被视为[太 obvious]被排除。推荐 0.1: XTC threshold. Words above this probability are excluded. Recommend 0.1~0.5. Default 0.1.
启用/禁用/自动推理（思考）功能。off 时加载更快，on 开启思考过程但加载稍: Enable/disable/auto reasoning (thinking). off=faster load, on=thinking enabled. Works with all MTP models.
Mirostat 学习率。模型多快适应文本变化。推荐 0.05~0.1（快），创: Mirostat learning rate. How fast the model adapts. Recommend 0.05~0.1 (fast), 0.01 for creative writing (stable). Default 0.01.
启用仅嵌入模式（禁用聊天和生成功能）。加载向量模型（如 Qwen3-Embedd: Enable embedding-only mode (disables chat and generation). Auto-checked when loading vector models. Uncheck to restore text generation.
XTC 采样概率。以该概率排除[太 obvious]的词，迫使模型选生僻词。推荐: XTC sampling probability. Excludes obvious words at this probability. Recommend 0.1~0.3. 0.0=disabled. Great for creative writing and roleplay.
